name: Nayax
services: Cashless payments with VPOS Touch and Onyx
description: Nayax provides cashless payment acceptance, telemetry, management software, and consumer engagement tools for unattended retail businesses. Operators use VPOS Touch and Onyx card readers, the Nayax Core management platform, the MoMa mobile app, and Monyx Wallet payment and loyalty tools. The Nova Market kiosk supports self-checkout in micro markets. This source supports the existing Nayax demonstration account and its global unattended retail content; service availability, accepted payment methods, compatibility, and commercial terms depend on the market and merchant agreement.
